title: Vortex Filaments in Hermitian Reductive Lie Algebras
summary: It is well-known that the investigation of vortex filaments (i.e., moving curves) in the Euclidean 3-space $\mathbb R^3$ is an attractive topic both in physics and mathematics. The theory consists mainly of the three vortex models, up to the third-order approximation. Such a theory has been successfully extended to Hermitian symmetric Lie algebras in mathematics with physical and geometrical backgrounds.
